About

Operations thinking.
Technical execution.

I work at the intersection of business operations, platforms and automation. I bring a versatile set of skills to each project: process analysis, technical troubleshooting, workflow design, AI orchestration and clear documentation. I use that foundation to tackle unfamiliar problems, learn what is needed and choose a solution that fits. My approach is simple: understand the problem, plan the workflow, build and test, then improve and maintain. I make a deliberate effort to leave things better than I found them, with simpler processes and clearer handoffs.
